summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing CFO Robert Long will leave in July 2026. Chair Ron Edmonds becomes Interim CFO, stepping aside from Chair; Deputy Chair Admiral Robert Natter resumes Chair role. No financial terms, premiums, or dates beyond departure month. The board is conducting a search for a permanent CFO. This is a voluntary, orderly CFO departure with planned interim succession; not a forced or abrupt change but still a management change event. No advisory or deal mechanics. Watch for timing and outcome of the CFO search and any potential leadership instability.
